Hi Samira — thanks for the prompt send and the attachments. A few clarifying asks before Procurement can push PO creation to Accounting: 

1) Beneficial owner / UBO: We need a completed UBO declaration (simple form) confirming ownership percentage for tax records. If your legal team has an internal equivalent, that’s fine — please mark the signer and include title.
2) Signing authority proof: a scanned gov ID or a corporate signatory letter showing Samira Patel as authorized to sign tax docs.
3) Treaty claim specifics: On the W-8BEN-E you indicated treaty benefits. Please confirm the exact treaty article and the type of income (service fees/licensing) so Accounting can set the correct withholding code.
4) VAT & remittance: We will capture VAT reg number for our records; please confirm the VAT number as printed on the certificate and a preferred remittance email for AP.

We can provisionally create a PO in our system to avoid delays and mark it as conditional pending the UBO and signatory evidence. If you can get items 1–2 returned by Monday, we’ll target PO issuance by Tue 14 Sep.

I’ve cc’d Jordan (payments) and Kimberly (tax compliance) to keep them in the loop.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
